newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Solana, Primakov agree on Russia-NATO deal.
newsitem.headline: Solana, Primakov agree on Russia-NATO deal.

text.p: NATO Secretary General Javier Solana and Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov agreed terms on Wednesday for a deal mapping out relations between Moscow and the Western alliance, alliance sources said.

The sources said the agreement, reached by Solana and Primakov at talks in Moscow, now needed official approval by leaders of NATO countries. It could be signed on May 27, the target date set by President Boris Yeltsin.
"The work on the document has been completed at their (Primakov and Solana's) level," one NATO source said after Primakov and Solana met for the second day.
He said once formal approval was obtained, the two sides were now "in readiness for signing on May 27".
The agreement is intended to chart peaceful relations between Moscow and NATO into the next century and address Russian concerns over NATO's eastward expansion plans. No details were available.
